cushion of 1 over Blake - the bar has him at even money
2 clear with 2 to play - points only go up, but so does the tension
3 above the cellar - the trapdoor creaks every time he wipes
the gap to Blake is 4 - his short game is now a public interest matter
done and dangling 6 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
finished with a 6-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
safe-ish by 7 - the blue balls have come back from further
finished 7 above the blue line - toasting every point Blake does not score
8 clear and finished - now a full-time Blake supporter
